tables.heading: Exit codes and result records of the engine
rows: Every phase approved, in this run or before it, and release verification passed or not required

Internal error (no member); the working directory cannot be entered (no member); the MALFORMED limit reached (`critic_unavailable`); the proposer ended without phase evidence on a status that has no mapping (`proposer_no_evidence`)
Rejects exceeded (`max_rejects`); the commit-gate halt (`commit_gate`); oscillation (`gate_oscillation`); release verification failed (`release_verification`)

Invalid spec, configuration or argument (no member); the preflight of verification failed (no member); a configuration error of the critic (`critic_config`); a changed source (`critic_config`, the blocked reason `source-changed` of §E.2)
Wall-clock budget; the results 4, 7, 8, 9, 10 of the pass loop; the wait ceiling of a quota pause
The workspace lock is held (start mode `standalone`)
Stop request, or the result 6 of the pass loop; the owner of the lease was lost

tables.heading: Exit codes and result records of the engine
tables.subheading: Pass loop (result record; not a process)
rows: Invalid overlay declaration or scope, passed through; a stop before a pass because a source changed, with the field `blocked` set to `source-changed`
Pass limit; a plugin was installed on the final pass
Consecutive errors; a plugin request was refused or failed. Quota classes do not count
Yield limit, yield deadline, or the wall clock spent during a yield
Consecutive kills at the ceiling of a pass
Interrupt, termination; only with an overlay of scope `attempt`
Any kill of one pass by a watchdog. Kept in the record of the pass
The command of the harness was not found. The loop goes on until a breaker ends it. Kept in the record of the pass
